name: Distributed Volume Rendering Pipeline
definition: A software architecture for distributed direct volume rendering on HPC systems, structured as a pipeline with loosely coupled stages (data distribution, rendering, compositing, display) that can be generically replaced with custom logic using subclassing.
summary: The Distributed Volume Rendering Pipeline is a parallel software architecture that structures direct volume rendering as a loosely coupled pipeline to hide I/O costs and achieve interactive framerates on HPC systems.
